Small settings popup touches.

### Changed
- **Refresh shows its progress on the button:** it reads Refresh, then Refreshing…, then Done, then goes back to Refresh.
- **Version and GitHub link** sit next to the Detour title at the top, instead of in a footer.

Everything else is as in [0.5.4](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.5.4).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
